title: Chapter 335 To The Time And Space Palace
content:
Chapter 335 To The Time And Space Palace

Looking at Langcang Mountain in front of Lu Daosheng.

The rest of the people in the Dome Heavenly Palace reacted only then.

Plop.

Suddenly, a large number of people knelt in front of Lu Daosheng.

They knew that the other side of the starry sky was about to change.

From now on, there will never be a second sound on the other side of the starry sky.

Fortunately, their Dome Heavenly Palace has long become this adult.

Therefore, if the entire starry sky is unified, they must be those with higher status.

Facing the voluntary surrender of the Dome Heavenly Palace, Lu Daosheng was not surprised at all.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng waved his hand and teleported directly to the deserted city with everyone.

At this moment, the deserted city has regained its vitality again.

Everyone was no longer surprised by the deserted city that had changed again. The streets of the outer city were still bustling and bustling.

There were endless shouts of setting up stalls and laughter from taverns.

Everyone looked at the deserted city in front of them and was amazed. Unexpectedly, there was such a place full of fireworks in this world.

Lu Daosheng slowly ascended to the deserted city.

A huge figure appeared in the eyes of the world.

"Look! It's the city lord!!"

"Master Lord!!"

"Master Lord!!!"

Everyone in the Huangcheng looked at Lu Daosheng in the void and felt excited.

They have never seen their own city lord in countless years.

It's really a long time.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng was also seen on the other side of the starry sky, and his expression became solemn.

Now, even if the news is not well informed, I still know what is happening on the other side of the starry sky.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded, like the sound of the great way, echoing in everyone's ears.

"From this moment, the other side of the starry sky will be completely unified, and all forces will be affiliated with the deserted city."

"If there are any objections, the consequences will be borne by you."

As soon as the words fell, they were above the void.

Boom!

The terrifying and ferocious heavenly disaster suddenly fell from all over the other side of the starry sky, making the sentient beings on the other side of the starry sky panic.

At this moment, even the supreme heavenly way on the other side of the starry sky was congratulating Lu Daosheng.

How dare the other forces refuse?

In the end, no matter how big or small the forces on the other side of the starry sky, they all sent the highest representatives and brought the heavy benefits of their respective forces to the deserted city.

Another shock.

Without exception, every outsider who entered the deserted city could not help but look shocked.

There is such a paradise in this world.

If you live here, you must be very happy.

Everyone thought this way, and then slowly headed towards the city lord's mansion under the leadership of Huang Wei.

But for some reason, they always felt that as soon as they entered the deserted city, it seemed as if countless pairs of eyes were staring at them in the dark, which made them all feel palpitations.

"Mr. Lord, you've all arrived."

Deep in the city lord's mansion, inside a mansion.

Awei looked respectful and spoke to Lu Daosheng.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng lay on the chair of the Grand Master, waving while waving his hands casually.

"You can handle such a small matter yourself."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Awei was slightly stunned and nodded immediately.

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

Wait until Awei left.

Yan Lingyun slowly walked out of the house.

"Have you lay flat again?"

Looking at Lu Daosheng who was a little leisurely, Yan Lingyun stepped forward and pushed her directly.

After he calmed down, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I'm just thinking about things."

Taking advantage of Yan Lingyun's inattention, Lu Daosheng pulled Yan Lingyun into his arms.

Feeling the softness in his arms, Lu Dao's hands became honest.

"Don't, don't make a fuss."

Yan Lingyun's pretty face turned slightly red and she wanted to break free, but she could not compare with Lu Daosheng. Since she couldn't resist, she simply gave up on resisting.

"I'm going to go to the Nether Sea."

At this time, when Lu Daosheng was about to take further action, Yan Lingyun suddenly said.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned and frowned slightly.

"Minghai? After the other side of the starry sky stabilizes, just ask Yunqi to lead the army to suppress Minghai."

Although his strength is not very weak, Lu Daosheng obviously looks down on him.

But it was just some gangsters with some strength who gathered together.

At that time, Chen Yu needed to rely on the power of the Nether Sea to rule the other side of the starry sky, but Lu Daosheng didn't need it.

In addition, the Minghai did not have any substantial help except providing Chen Yu with some deterrence, so Lu Daosheng was too lazy to pay attention to them.

"I have been in the Nether Sea, and it was very chaotic. At that time, I swore that one day, I would unify the entire Nether Sea and restore order there."

Yan Lingyun spoke plainly, her eyes full of memories of the past.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng was suddenly surprised.

Unexpectedly, my wife and Minghai still have a story.

"Then you go, it's just right, I'm going to have something to do, too."

"good."

Immediately, Yan Lingyun was about to get up.

But at this time, Lu Daosheng suppressed her again.

"Before you can go there, it's better to have some activity first."

Lu Daosheng smiled and then used his thundering method.

In an instant, the courtyard was full of scenery, and an exquisite fruit was unreservedly exposed to Lu Daosheng.

"you!"

After Yan Lingyun reacted, she immediately wanted to subconsciously resist.

But then her tense body quickly softened again.

It’s all an old husband and wife, there’s no need.

Seeing Yan Lingyun slowly closing her eyes and picking her eyes, Lu Daosheng smiled and walked slowly into the house with a princess hug.

......

A few days later.

The other side of the starry sky gradually returned to peace.

The disputes of the past no longer exist and have turned into a prosperous appearance.

In the deserted city.

It was still Awei Anxing and Gu Chen who controlled the affairs of all sizes in the deserted city.

However, there are more and more things in their hands.

The owner of the deserted city disappeared into the deserted city again.

At the same time, a hazy place.

The complex power of time and space continues to permeate.

A giant stood here.

The Palace of Time and Space!

A force that controls the order of countless world time and space.

At this time, a figure appeared in front of the Palace of Time and Space.

Lu Daosheng.

Looking at the Time and Space Hall in front of him, Lu Daosheng felt a little moved.

The Palace of Time and Space was the earliest order force he came into contact with.

Almost every world he has the figure of the Time and Space Palace.

Buzz —

At this time, the void trembled.

A man dressed in elegant clothes appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"The Lord of the Time and Space Palace won the Time and Space, and I have met the Lord."

Time and Space Win salute Lu Daosheng.

At this moment, his eyes were full of complexity.

This is the first time I have seen such a mysterious figure in charge of the long river of time and space that has been in charge of endless years.

Even in the long river of time and space, you cannot see the existence in front of you.
